Compact SD proportions, total body height EXACTLY THREE HEAD HEIGHTS: a very large rounded head comprises one third of total height; short compact torso and short legs. Clearly adult face, not baby. Short dark-brown textured hair, warm skin, light-gray plain sleeveless shirt, charcoal shorts, barefoot. Near arm gently held forward away from torso; far arm held slightly back; one visible hand per arm. Two clear feet separated at baseline. Clean small game sprite suitable for a 128x128 canvas, confident square pixel clusters with at most 24 flat colors, one flat shadow per material, crisp outline, absolutely no soft shading, glow, gradients, blur, lighting halos or antialiasing. Show the full body with empty margin on all sides. Actually transparent RGBA background, with fully opaque sprite pixels and zero-alpha background. No solid backdrop, no floor or cast shadow. No text, sheet, frames, equipment, jacket, bag, gloves, shoes, hat, weapon, scenery or other character. The design is for later modular hair/expression/jacket/pants/shoe replacement. Prioritize the three-head-tall silhouette and correct anatomy above fine detail.
